# KPP Generated Mechanism Code

This directory contains Fortran code generated by the Kinetic Pre-Processor (KPP).

## License

Code in this directory is derived from KPP and is distributed under GPLv3.
See upstream KPP repository (https://github.com/KineticPreProcessor/KPP) for the
original LICENSE.txt.

## DO NOT EDIT

Files in this directory are auto-generated. Any modification will be lost on
regeneration. To modify a mechanism, edit the source `.kpp` file and re-run KPP.

## Regeneration

```bash
# From the atmospheric_chemistry module root:
/path/to/kpp/bin/kpp kpp/upstream/src/your_mech.kpp kpp/generated/your_mech
```

## File naming convention

- `{mech}_Parameters.f90` — Species/reaction constants
- `{mech}_Global.f90` — Shared state arrays
- `{mech}_Function.f90` — FUN() RHS evaluation
- `{mech}_Jacobian.f90` — JAC() sparse Jacobian
- `{mech}_Integrator.f90` — INTEGRATE() time-stepping
- `{mech}_LinearAlgebra.f90` — KPP sparse linear solver
- `{mech}_Rates.f90` — Rate coefficient computation
- `{mech}_Monitor.f90` — Diagnostic utilities
